title: The southbound schedule
logline: After the route: a schedule board in the Seattle station, southbound, the times listed and none of them circled. The last page of the sequence in the box, not in the book. Nobody took it.

panels.composition: A bus station's departures board for southbound routes, a column of times, none marked, a bench beneath it empty, fluorescent light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bus station departures board listing a column of southbound times with none marked, an empty bench beneath it under fluorescent light, no words legible
image.notes: Book order: not printed; box order: last. Recorded for the register.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
